example.message: Team already has an active mission.

FieldError.description: field is body/query field name, id, or body for malformed JSON. Never include rejected values.

Id.description: Canonical lowercase UUID; server-generated for new resources.

Report.description: PENDING: no disasterId/rejectionReason/verifiedAt/rejectedAt. VERIFIED: disasterId and verifiedAt required, rejection fields absent. REJECTED: rejectionReason and rejectedAt required, verification fields absent. No mission data. Withdrawn reports never returned.

ReportPage.description: Own PageResponse, never Spring Page. Counts after authorization and all filters, before pagination. totalPages=ceil(totalElements/size); empty total is 0 pages; page beyond end returns empty items, 200.

Timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC, Z suffix, up to nanoseconds.
